name: Singleness
overview: Scripture acknowledges that being alone was not part of God's original design, as seen in His creation of a helper suitable for man (Genesis 2:18). Yet singleness is also embraced in God's sovereign timing, with a season and purpose for every condition under heaven (Ecclesiastes 3:1). The Lord assures His presence and strength to those who may feel alone, promising to uphold them with His righteousness (Isaiah 41:10) and identifying Himself as the faithful husband and redeemer of His people (Isaiah 54:5). Ultimately, singleness is an opportunity to fear the Lord and find lasting worth beyond outward beauty (Proverbs 31:30), resting in God's good plans for peace and hope (Jeremiah 29:11).
